senses.gloss:
नल् नल्, cl. 1. P. नलति, &c., to smell;
to pain (?); to bind (?); cl. 10. P. नाल-
यति, &c., to speak or shine; to bind or confine,
(the two meanings ‘smelling’ and ‘binding’ have
probably arisen from a confusion between गन्धे
and बन्धे in the Dhātu-pāṭha.)

नल नल, अस्, m. (for नड, q. v.), a species
of reed, Amphidonax Karka, eight to twelve feet
high [cf. नड, नाल, देव-नल]; N. of a king of
the Niṣadhas or of the country called Niṣadha, son
of Vīra-sena and husband of Damayantī and hero of
the celebrated tale called Nala and Damayantī; a son
of Niṣadha and father of Nabha or Nabhas; a
descendant of the latter Nala, son of Su-dhanvan and
father of Uktha [cf. नड]; N. of a son of Yadu;
N. of a monkey-chief, son of Tvaṣṭṛ or Viśva-
karman, who made a bridge for Rāma from the
continent to Laṅkā; N. of a Daitya; N. of a
medical author; (in astrology) N. of a particular
form of constellation in which all the planets or stars
are grouped in double mansions; a deified proge-
nitor, wrongly written for नल्व; (ई), f. a kind of
fragrant substance, a perfume (= नटी); red arsenic,
= मनः-सिला, कुनटी; (अम्), n. the blossom of
Nelumbium Speciosum (?); smell, odour; [cf. rt. नल्.]
—नल-कानन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people, (this
word may perhaps be separated into नलक-आनन;
also read नल-कालक, नभ-कानन.)
—नल-
कील, अस्, m. the knee.
—नल-कूबर and नल-
कूवर, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kuvera.
—नल-
चम्पू, ऊस्, f., N. of a work by Tri-vikrama-bhaṭṭa,
also called Damayantī-kathā, describing the fortunes
of Nala and Damayantī in a highly artificial mixed
style, half prose, half verse; [cf. चम्पू.]
—नल-
द, अम्, आ, n. f. Indian spikenard, Nardostachys Ja-
tamansi (= जटामांसी); (अम्), n. the root of Andro-
pogon Muricatus (= उशीर); the honey or nectar
of a flower; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of Raudrāśva.
—नल-पट्टिका, f. a sort of mat made with reeds,
a coarse mat.
—नल-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—नल-मीन, अस्, m. a species of sprat or (according
to some) a shrimp or prawn; (also read तल-मीन.)
—नल-सेतु, उस्, m. ‘Nala's bridge,’ the causeway
constructed by the monkey Nala, (a name given to
the rocks between Ramisseram and Ceylon, com-
monly called Adam's bridge.)
—नलेश्वर-तीर्थ
(˚ल-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
—न-
लोत्तम (˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, m. a species of reed (= देव-
नल).
—नलोदय (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘Nala's rise,’
N. of an artificial poem ascribed to Kāli-dāsa and
describing the restoration of the fallen Nala to pros-
perity and power.
—नलोपख्यान (˚ल-उप्˚), अम्,
n. ‘the story of Nala (and Damayantī),’ N. of a
celebrated episode of the Mahā-bhārata.
नल्ल नल्ल, wrongly for नल्व.

नाल नाल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नल), consisting
of reeds, made of a reed or reeds; (आ or ई, अम्), f. n.
a hollow or tubular stalk, especially the stalk of the
lotus [cf. खर-न्˚], of a pot-herb, &c.; (अम्), n.
any pipe or tube or tubular vessel of the body, the
windpipe, urethra, &c.; a handle; = ताल, आल,
yellow orpiment; (आ), f., N. of a river; (ई), f. an
instrument for perforating an elephant's ear; a piece
of metal on which the hours are struck (= घटी);
a period of twenty-four minutes; a lotus flower.
—नाल-वंश, अस्, m. = नल, a reed.

नलक, अम्, n. a bone (hollow like a reed),
any long bone of the body; the tibia; the radius of
the arm; (इका), f. a kind of fragrant substance (=
नली, commonly पवारी or पन्ठारी); the legu-
minous plant Dolichos Lablab; the plant Polianthes
Tuberosa; Dæmia Extensa.
नालक for नाल in चारु-नालक, q. v.

नलकिनी, f. (fr. an unused नलकिन्), the knee-cap
or knee-pan; the leg.
नालकिनी = नालीकिनी, q. v.
नलदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, dealing in Indian spikenard.

नलित, अस्, m. a species of vegetable, (commonly
नालिता.)

नालिता नालिता, f. an esculent root, Arum
Colocasia.

नलिन, अम्, n. (connected with नल, its stalk
being hollow like that of a reed), a lotus flower or
water-lily, Nelumbium Speciosum or Nymphæa Ne-
lumbo; the indigo plant; water; (ई), f. a lotus,
Nelumbium Speciosum, the flexible stalk of the water-
lily; an assemblage of the Nelumbium Speciosum or
of lotus flowers; a pond in which the lotus grows or
may grow, a place abounding in lotuses, (नलिनी is
to नलिन as अब्जिनी to अब्ज, पङ्कजिनी to पङ्क-
ज, and पद्मिनी to पद्म); the Ganges of heaven
or rather an arm of it; a mystical N. of one of the
[]
nostrils (= नलिका); a kind of fragrant substance;
the fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoa-nut;
N. of the wife of Aja-mīḍha and mother of Nīla;
(अस्), m. the Indian crane (as a synonym of पुष्-
कर); a species of shrub (= कृष्ण-पाक-फल).
—नलिन-दल, अम्, n. a leaf of the lotus flower;
[cf. नलिनी-दल, नव-नलिन-दलाय.]
—नलिनी-
खण्ड, अम्, n. an assemblage of the Nelumbium
Speciosum.
—नलिनी-दल, अम्, n. a leaf of the
lotus plant; [cf. नलिन-दल.]
—नलिनी-नन्दन,
अम्, n. ‘the divine garden near the Nalinī (?),’ N. of
a garden of Kuvera.
—नलिनी-पद्म-कोष, अस्,
m., N. of a particular position of the hands in
dancing.
—नलिनी-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, what comes
forth or has come forth from a Nelumbium Speci-
osum; (अस्), m. an epithet of Brahmā; (अम्), n.
the fibres of the stalk of Nelumbium Speciosum.
—नलिने-शय, अस्, m. (नलिने, loc. sing.), ‘reclin-
ing on a lotus,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu.
नलिनीक at the end of comp. = नलिनी, q. v.

नल्व नल्व, अस्, m. a furlong, a measure
of distance = 400 or 104 (?) cubits; (wrongly read
नल्ल, नल.)
—नल्व-वर्त्मग, अस्, आ, अम्, going
the distance of a Nalva; (आ), f. a spreading plant; the
orange tree (= काकाङ्गी for नारङ्ग?).

नालायित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. an unused Nom. ना-
लाय), representing the handle (of an axe).
नालि, इस्, f. = नाडी, any tubular vessel of the body.

नालिक, अस्, m. a buffalo; (आ), f. a stalk, the stalk
of a lotus, a tube, see गन्ध-न्˚, कपाल-न्˚; a
species of pot-herb (= नालिता); a species of plant
(= चर्म-कषा); an instrument for piercing an
elephant's ear; = नाडी, a period of twenty-four
minutes; (अम्), n. a lotus flower [cf. नालीक];
myrrh; a kind of wind instrument, (perhaps) a flute;
a peculiar manner of sitting.

नालीक, अस्, m. an arrow (= नाराच, but in the
epic poetry different from it); a dart, a javelin, a
pike; body, limb (?); a lotus; the fibrous stalk of
the lotus; (अम्), n. an assemblage of lotus flowers.

नालिनी, f. (fr. an unused form नालिन्, which is de-
rived fr. नाल), a mystical N. of one nostril.

नालीकिनी, f. (fr. an unused form नालीकिन्, which
[]
is derived fr. नालीक), a multitude or assemblage
of lotus flowers, a lotus lake.

नालन्द नालन्द, N. of a village near Rāja-
gṛha containing a celebrated Buddhist monastery.
नालन्दर, N. of a Buddhist monastery.

नालिकेर नालिकेर, अस्, m. the cocoa-nut
tree, the cocoa-nut; N. of a district to the south-east
of Madhya-deśa.

नालिकेल, अम्, n. the cocoa-nut; (various reading
for नालिकेर.)

नालिजङ्घ नालि-जङ्घ, अस्, m. a raven or
the carrion-crow; [cf. नाडी-जङ्घ.]

नालीप नालीप, अस्, m. = कदम्बक; per-
haps for कडम्बक, the stalk of a pot-herb.

नालीव्रण नाली-व्रण, अस्, m. a fistulous or
sinus^1 sore (= नाडी-व्रण).
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.
नलोपख्यान; read नलोपाख्यान.
